body:
🛠️ Craftable Unobtainables Datapack
Tired of searching endless End Cities or raiding dozens of Woodland Mansions? This datapack adds custom crafting recipes for three of the most powerful, uncraftable survival items in Minecraft!

✨ Added Recipes:
🪆 Totem of Undying

🦅 Elytra

🍎 Enchanted Golden Apple (God Apple)

📥 How to Install:
Download the datapack .zip file.

Open your Minecraft game, select your world, click Edit, and then Open World Folder.

Open the datapacks folder and drop the .zip file inside.

Go back to the game, load into your world, and type /reload in the chat.

💡 Tip: Use the in-game Recipe Book or mods like JEI (Just Enough Items) / REI (Roughly Enough Items) to easily view the custom crafting shapes!

🚀 Features:
Survival Friendly: Perfectly balanced recipes designed for vanilla survival.

Lightweight: No lag, completely optimized for any 1.20+ server or singleplayer world.

Enjoy your enhanced survival experience! If you like this datapack, don't forget to leave a diamond or a comment!
